title: Son of God
gist: In the Old Testament 'son of God' can name Israel as a people (Exodus 4:22), the Davidic king (Psalm 2:7), or the angels. In the Gospels it moves from a royal and messianic title to a confession of who Jesus is: at the baptism and the Transfiguration the Father's voice calls him his beloved Son, and the centurion at the cross confesses him.
original: Hebrew ben Elohim / ben Yahweh; Greek huios tou theou.

passages.note: 'Thou art my son, this day have I begotten thee.'
Declared Son of God in power by the resurrection.
